comment: Public example dotenv files (templates and samples published as such), pinned by commit and SHA-256. tools/realworld.py pin resolves a ref to its commit (git ls-remote) and records the digest and the license file's first lines; fetch downloads exactly these bytes into the census cache. The files' contents are never committed (results/realworld.md holds keys, statistics and value digests only) and never executed: Bash never sources them, Ruby's command substitutions are recorded, not run.
